0:
[eaton]
  driver = usbhid-ups
  port = auto
  vendorid = 0463
  # NUT decides low battery from these instead of the UPS's own, much lower, threshold
  ignorelb
  override.battery.charge.low = 50
  override.battery.runtime.low = 480
  # shutdown.return cuts the outlets after offdelay seconds, then restores them ondelay
  # seconds after the command once mains is back. both count from the command. The
  # router shares the outlets, so it gets 3 hours, about what the battery holds once
  # the nodes are off. If mains returns sooner, the cut still power-cycles the halted nodes
  offdelay = 10800
  ondelay = 10860

0:
CMDSCRIPT "/bin/sh /etc/nut/upssched.sh"
PIPEFN /run/nut/upssched.pipe
LOCKFN /run/nut/upssched.lock
AT ONBATT * START-TIMER shutdown 600
AT ONLINE * CANCEL-TIMER shutdown

0:
export HOME=/tmp
export UV_CACHE_DIR=/tmp/uv
export XDG_CACHE_HOME=/tmp/.cache
# Pin mcp<2: the server uses the v1 FastMCP API
# (mcp.server.fastmcp); mcp 2.x renamed it to MCPServer.
exec uv run --no-project \
  --with 'mcp<2' --with google-auth --with requests \
  /config/calendar_mcp.py
